messages:
jules: Hi 👋 hitting a wall on onboarding: Okta accepted my password but when I try to enroll MFA it says 'unable to send SMS' and then blocks enrollment. I don't have a phone on my Google profile yet. Anyone seen this flow?

it-ops: Hey @jules, sometimes SMS is our default fallback. We prefer passkeys or YubiKeys for new hires. Quick check: can you open Okta > Settings > Edit Profile and confirm phone number exists? If not, add a temporary number and try again.

jules: I don't see an Edit Profile option — only security settings. Looks like my profile is locked down.

tia_security: We lock edit for some fields until provisioning completes. @it-ops can you check if jules has the "canEditPhone" flag?

it-ops: On it. Reviewing Okta user attributes... provisioning note: phone writes are disabled for accounts created via HR SSO until group 'allow-profile-edit' is applied. @nate can you add jules to that group?

nate: Added jules to allow-profile-edit. You should be able to add a phone now, @jules. If Okta still blocks, try incognito to avoid cached assertions.

jules: I can edit now and added my phone. Retrying MFA enrollment...

ops-bot: okta-provisioner: attribute-sync job completed for jules (uid: 21987).

jules: Enrollment failed again but now shows "Register a security key" option. I have a passkey on my iPhone (Touch ID). Can I use that instead of SMS?

tia_security: Yes — passkeys are supported. Choose "Add security key" in Okta and follow the browser prompt. Note: if you plan to use YubiKey for CLI/SSH, that's a separate PIV step; passkey is fine for Okta web login.

jules: Web passkey enrollment worked! One thing: how do I get 1Password access for vaults and CLI? I clicked link earlier but it required org invite.

1password-bot: Invite sent to jules@redwood.com. Follow the link to create an account. For CLI: install `op` and run `op signin --account redwood`. If you need emergency access, request an expiring guest invite from Security.

jules: Got the 1Password invite and signed in. CLI signin prompt asked for Secret Key — where do I find that?

it-ops: After you create your account in the browser, the Secret Key is shown on the final setup page and saved in your vault under "My Account". If you missed it, use the account recovery link or contact 1password-bot to resend the setup flow.

jules: Found it, CLI signin worked. Thanks all. Two small asks for onboarding docs: 1) note that HR-created accounts may block phone edits initially, and 2) call out passkey flow as preferred over SMS. I'll open a PR on the handbook.

tia_security: Good notes. @jules please add a short snippet and tag security for wording.

jules: Done, PR link: https://redwood.internal/docs/handbook/pull/321 — flagged for review. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
